title: Sketchpad Platform Refactor
description: Rename ProductRuntime to Platform; replace board/scene3d with table/puzzle2d/puzzle3d/puzzle5d/cad/panel component kinds; rewrite sketchpad as declarative Platform instance with home/kit table + kit diagram slice.
summary: Clean rewrite: deleted 53k-line shell.tsx. @semio/sketchpad index.ts is ~600 lines of pure Platform product (Component subclasses, window bodies, kit registry bridge, browser navigation). Boot is boot.ts calling mountPlatform(ensureSketchpadPlatform) only. Desktop, docs, vscode use generic platform renderer. Legacy sync/xstate/GoldenLayout removed; kit open/commands return via future platform contributions.
